paper.title_en: Observational Indistinguishability and the Beginning of the Universe
paper.abstract_en: Can we infer whether all of physical reality began to exist? Several novel results are offered suggesting a negative verdict. First, two necessary (but not necessarily sufficient) conditions are offered for a cosmic beginning. Second, I discuss three theorems which show that, in a wide range of spacetimes, observers cannot infer the global structure of their spacetime; one of the three shows that spacetimes satisfying a condition necessary for a cosmic beginning are observationally indistinguishable from spacetimes which do not satisfy that condition. Next, I offer two extensions to the aforementioned theorems. The two extensions show that, in an equally wide range of spacetimes, observers cannot collect sufficient data to determine whether the application conditions for the class singularity theorems are satisfied or whether their spacetime satisfies the two necessary conditions for a cosmic beginning. Lastly, a reply is offered to the objection that the skeptical consequences of the aforementioned theorems can be overcome with induction. Importantly, all past singular dust FLRW spacetimes are observationally indistinguishable from counterparts which, while sharing a number of important local properties, either do not include a singularity to the past of every point or else do not have the sort of time ordering intuitively required for a cosmic beginning.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文针对宇宙是否有一个开端这一广义相对论基础问题，提出了宇宙开端的两个必要条件，并讨论三个关于观察者无法推断其时空整体结构的定理，以及两个扩展结果和对归纳法反驳的回应。其论证大量依赖奇点定理与时空整体结构，属于广义相对论基础与宇宙学哲学的核心议题，理论深度较高，适合研究者进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: 观测不可区分性与宇宙的开端
decision.abstract_zh: 我们能否推断整个物理实在是否开始存在？本文提供了若干新结果，倾向于给出否定的判定。首先，给出了宇宙开端的两个必要条件（但未必是充分条件）。其次，我讨论了三个定理，它们表明在广泛范围的时空中，观察者无法推断其时空的整体结构；其中三个定理之一表明，满足宇宙开端的一个必要条件的时空，与不满足该条件的时空在观测上不可区分。接下来，我对上述定理给出两个扩展。这两个扩展表明，在同样广泛范围的时空中，观察者无法收集到足够数据以确定经典奇点定理的适用条件是否被满足，或者其时空是否满足宇宙开端的两个必要条件。最后，我对如下反驳作出回应：上述定理的怀疑论后果可以通过归纳法克服。重要的是，所有过去的奇点尘埃FLRW时空，都与某些对应时空在观测上不可区分，而这些对应时空虽然共享若干重要的局部性质，却要么不包含每个点过去方向的奇点，要么不具有直观上为宇宙开端所需的那种时间排序。
